.p6{padding-bottom:30px}.p6-hero{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ecf3fb,#fff);border:1px solid #dce7f0;border-radius:17px;padding:24px;margin:22px 0}.p6-hero span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.13em;font-weight:900;color:#af884e}.p6-hero h2{margin:8px 0;font-size:23px}.p6-hero p{color:#6b829b;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}.p6-error{border:1px solid #eab9a9;background:#fff0eb;padding:13px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12px;color:#9a4c3e}.p6-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:11px;margin:17px 0}.p6-stats>div{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dfe8f0;border-radius:13px;padding:16px}.p6-stats small,.p6-stats strong,.p6-stats span{display:block}.p6-stats small{font-size:11px;color:#637e96}.p6-stats strong{font-size:27px;color:#24577e;margin:11px 0 4px}.p6-stats span{color:#8c9eae;font-size:10px}.p6-columns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.p6-panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dfe9f0;border-radius:14px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:14px}.p6-panel h3{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 17px}.p6-panel-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:11px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:17px}.p6-panel-header h3{margin:0}.p6-panel-header>span{font-size:11px;color:#6c849b}.p6-empty{padding:18px;background:#f3f7fa;border-radius:10px;color:#8499aa;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}.p6-bars{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:8px;min-height:198px}.p6-bar-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:7px}.p6-bar-col b{font-size:12px;color:#2b698f;height:18px}.p6-bar-track{height:125px;width:100%;max-width:32px;background:#eff4f8;border-radius:7px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;overflow:hidden}.p6-bar-track span{display:block;width:100%;background:#4289aa;border-radius:7px 7px 0 0;min-height:0}.p6-bar-col small{font-size:10px;color:#8199a8}.p6-skill{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:13px 1px;border-bottom:1px solid #edf1f4}.p6-skill>div:first-child strong,.p6-skill>div:first-child small{display:block}.p6-skill strong{font-size:13px}.p6-skill small{font-size:10px;color:#879cad;margin-top:5px}.p6-score{text-align:right}.p6-score b,.p6-score span{display:block}.p6-score b{font-size:12px;color:#267b5a}.p6-score span,.p6-not-graded{font-size:11px;color:#8a9bab}.p6-filter{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;border:1px solid #dce5ef;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden}.p6-filter button{background:#fff;border:0;padding:9px 12px;font-size:11px;color:#6f8295}.p6-filter button.active{background:#1b4d70;color:#fff}.p6-activity{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:13px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit!important;padding:14px 4px;border-top:1px solid #eef2f5}.p6-activity>div:first-child{flex:1;min-width:0}.p6-activity b,.p6-activity span{display:block}.p6-activity b{font-size:13px}.p6-activity span{font-size:11px;color:#8199aa;margin-top:6px}.p6-activity>div:last-child{text-align:right}.p6-activity small{display:block;color:#94a7b7;font-size:10px}.p6-activity>div:last-child strong{display:block;color:#2c688e;margin-top:8px;font-size:11px}.p6-recommendation{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;border:1px solid #dbe9ef;background:#f8fbfc;padding:14px;border-radius:10px;color:#244c66;text-decoration:none;margin-top:8px}.p6-recommendation strong{font-size:12px;min-width:80px}.p6-recommendation span{font-size:11px;color:#648096;flex:1;line-height:1.7}.p6-recommendation b{font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap}.p6-backup{background:#edf4f8;border:1px solid #dce9ef;border-radius:14px;padding:19px;margin:19px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:13px}.p6-backup h3{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 8px}.p6-backup p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.8;color:#71889b;max-width:560px}.p6-backup-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0}.p6-backup-actions button{border-radius:9px;background:#1e5375;color:white;padding:11px;border:1px solid #1e5375;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;min-height:41px}.p6-backup-actions button.destructive{background:white;color:#a15748;border-color:#e3bdb2}.p6-backup-actions button:disabled{opacity:.5}
@media(max-width:680px){.p6-hero{padding:18px}.p6-hero h2{font-size:19px}.p6-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.p6-stats>div{padding:13px}.p6-columns{grid-template-columns:1fr}.p6-panel{padding:17px 14px}.p6-filter button{padding:8px;font-size:10px}.p6-backup{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}.p6-backup-actions{flex-direction:row}.p6-backup-actions button{flex:1;min-width:0}.p6-recommendation{flex-wrap:wrap}.p6-recommendation span{min-width:55%}}
